question: Based on our customer pizza order information, summarize the total quantity of each ingredient used in the pizzas we delivered. Output the name and quantity for each ingredient.
sql:
WITH delivered_orders AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT co.order_id, co.pizza_id
    FROM pizza_clean_customer_orders co
    JOIN pizza_clean_runner_orders ro ON co.order_id = ro.order_id
    WHERE ro.cancellation IS NULL OR ro.cancellation = ''
),
pizza_toppings_expanded AS (
    SELECT 
        d.order_id,
        d.pizza_id,
        TRIM(SPLIT_PART(pr.toppings, ',', n.n)) AS topping_id
    FROM delivered_orders d
    JOIN pizza_recipes pr ON d.pizza_id = pr.pizza_id
    CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT UNNEST(GENERATE_SERIES(1, 10)) AS n) n
    WHERE TRIM(SPLIT_PART(pr.toppings, ',', n.n)) != ''
)
SELECT 
    pt.topping_name,
    COUNT(*) AS quantity
FROM pizza_toppings_expanded pte
JOIN pizza_toppings pt ON CAST(pte.topping_id AS INTEGER) = pt.topping_id
GROUP BY pt.topping_name
ORDER BY pt.topping_name
